title: 第13章 羽林军第14章 上任第一天
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
夏辰穿好武官官服，走出小院。
夏千已站在门口等候，而在他身后，还有三位气血鼎盛的男子。
夏辰一眼就看出这三人不是普通人，身上煞气环绕，光是站在那里一股彪悍之气便由内而生。
“少爷！”
四人一齐开口。
夏辰看到这三人并不意外，这是侯府的家兵，每一位出世的侯府子弟都会配几位家兵，一方面充当护卫，一方面也是根基，方便辅助侯府子弟快速掌握军队。
“走吧！”
夏辰点了点头，没有过多言语，五人安静的穿过侯府，从偏门中走出。
侯府屹立在京城最中心处，极为靠近皇宫，一出门便是中央大街，这条街道乃是800年前开国修建的，说是街道，但其实更相当于一个广场，可以同时容纳12架马车通行，极为宽广。
虽然还是清早，但此时，街道上就已极为的繁华，各种小贩等站在道路两旁，做着一些生计。
行人车水马龙，还有一些马车行走，随着黎明来到，偌大的京城如同一辆机器快速的运转了起来。
夏辰带着夏千几人，在路边随便的吃了个早餐，便直奔羽林卫衙门而去。
因为羽林卫管的是京城安危，有时皇室出行，还要充当护卫，所以并不驻扎在城外，在内城中便有固定衙门。
“站住！来者何人！”
夏辰来到一座靠近皇宫颇为气派的衙门面前，刚一接近便被拦下。
有全副武装穿着铠甲的士兵立刻上前，但态度还算客气。
“夏辰，今日前来上任！”
夏辰没有多做废话，也没有故意隐瞒身份，最后来个扮猪吃老虎，上演公子哥装逼打脸的情节。
他是来办实事的！
“夏校尉！”

门口的士兵瞬间肃然起敬，连忙行军礼。
他们早已收到消息，他们羽林卫中空降了一位校尉。
这位校尉来头惊人，乃镇东侯府嫡子。
夏辰点了点头，表情依旧严肃，给人一种生人勿近之感。
“校尉大人，我带您进去！”
站在前方的一位小头目，连忙走到夏辰身边，躬身态度谦卑，脸上堆满笑脸，亲自将夏辰迎了进去。
看着夏辰身影消失在衙门口，剩下的士兵这才大口呼吸，小声议论了起来。
“我的乖乖，啥时候咱们老大这么堆满笑脸过呀，笑的脸上都起褶子了。”
他们羽林卫，选拔标准非常严格，大多都是世袭，要么就是功勋子弟，再有一部分便是各大军营中，异常彪悍之人才能够进入。
加上又是天子亲军。
所以，大家都有一定的底气，平日里不要说校尉了，就是将军那也经常见，像一般校尉上任，他们虽然会客气，但绝不会如此卑微姿态。
但这次情况却着实不同。
“废话，你也不看来人是谁，虽说是个名满京城的废体，但架不住人家身份在那里呀！”
“这次空降咱们羽林卫，也不知道是好事还是坏事！”
“哈哈，咱们羽林卫中卧虎藏龙的，出了名的公子哥多，这次不过是多一个侯府嫡系而已，咱们看热闹就行！”
有士兵笑着说道，一边说着眼神中有期待之色。
……
content_en:
Xia Chen put on his military attaché uniform and walked out of the small courtyard.
Xia Qian was already waiting at the door, and behind him, there were three men with strong blood.
Xia Chen could tell at a glance that these three people were not ordinary people. They were surrounded by evil spirits, and a powerful aura was born from within just by standing there.
"Master!"
The four of them spoke together.
Xia Chen was not surprised to see these three people. They were the family soldiers of the Hou family. Every child of the Hou family who was born would be assigned several family soldiers. On the one hand, they served as guards, and on the other hand, they were also the foundation to help the children of the Hou family quickly master the army.
"Let's go!"
Xia Chen nodded without saying much. The five of them walked quietly through the Hou Mansion and walked out of the side door.
The Marquis Mansion stands in the center of the capital, very close to the palace. As soon as you step out, you will see Central Street. This street was built 800 years ago after the founding of the People's Republic of China. It is said to be a street, but in fact it is more like a square, which can accommodate 12 carriages at the same time. It is extremely wide.
Although it is still early in the morning, the streets are already extremely busy at this time, with various vendors standing on both sides of the road, doing some livelihood.
Pedestrians and cars were busy, and some carriages were walking. As dawn came, the huge capital city started to run rapidly like a machine.
Xia Chen took Xia Qian and others, had a casual breakfast on the roadside, and then went straight to the Yulin Wei Yamen.
Because the Yulin Guards were in charge of the safety of the capital, and sometimes the royal family had to act as guards when traveling, they were not stationed outside the city, but had fixed offices in the inner city.
"Stop! Who is coming!"
Xia Chen came to an impressive yamen near the palace and was stopped as soon as he approached.
There were soldiers in full armor who came forward immediately, but their attitude was still polite.
"Xia Chen, come and take office today!"
Xia Chen did not talk nonsense, nor did he deliberately hide his identity. In the end, he pretended to be a pig and eat the tiger, and staged the plot of the young master pretending to be a slap in the face.
He is here to do practical things!
"Captain Xia!"
The soldiers at the door immediately stood in awe and quickly performed a military salute.
They had already received news that a captain had airborne from their Yulin Guards.
This school captain had an astonishing background. He was the legitimate son of Zhendong Hou Mansion.
Xia Chen nodded, his expression still serious, giving people a feeling that strangers should not approach him.
"Lord Captain, I will take you in!"
A small leader standing in front quickly walked to Xia Chen, bowed humbly, and with a smile on his face, personally welcomed Xia Chen in.
Seeing Xia Chen's figure disappear at the yamen gate, the remaining soldiers took a deep breath and started talking in low voices.
"My darling, when did our boss have such a smile on his face? There are wrinkles on his face when he smiles."
Their Habayashi Guards have very strict selection criteria. Most of them are hereditary, or they are meritorious children, and some of them are only those who are extremely strong and strong in the major military camps.
In addition, it is the emperor's own army.
Therefore, everyone has a certain degree of confidence. On weekdays, not to mention captains, it is also common for generals. When general captains take office, although they will be polite, they will never be so humble.
But this time the situation is really different.
"Nonsense, you don't know who this person is. Even though he is a useless person who is famous all over the capital, you can't tell what his identity is!"
“I don’t know if our Habayashi Guards are parachuted this time, whether it’s a good thing or a bad thing!”
"Haha, in our Yulin Guard, we have the famous Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, Young Master Geduo. This time it's just another direct descendant of the Marquis Mansion. Let's just watch the fun!"
A soldier said with a smile, with a look of expectation in his eyes as he spoke.
